Content: “I belong to those scientists who consider that the drying up of the Aral Sea is far more advantageous than preserving it. `text(First)`, in its zone, good fertile land will be obtained... Cultivation of cotton alone will pay for the existing Aral Sea, with all its fisheries, shipping, and other industries. `text(Second)`, the disappearance of the Sea will not affect the region's landscapes.”
Copyright: A. Babayev, president of Soviet Turkmenistan's Academy of Sciences, `text(late 1950s)`
